title: Coefficient-exact triangles for cones of regular-immersion classes
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a regular closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ of Noetherian schemes with $\ell$ invertible, of constant codimension $c\geq0$. Regular means locally cut out by a regular sequence [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. For $r\geq1$ put $A_r=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$ and let $\eta_r:A_{r,Z}\to i_r^!A_{r,X}(c)[2c]$ be the supported Kummer class of [lem-per-regular-immersion-class-calculus]. On ordinary etale derived categories with Tate twists [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], one can choose cones $C_r$ of the actual maps $\eta_r$ so that for every $a,b\geq1$ there is a distinguished triangle
$$C_a\longrightarrow C_{a+b}\longrightarrow C_b\longrightarrow C_a[1]$$
in $D^+(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A_{a+b})$, with the outer complexes viewed there by restriction of scalars. These triangles are induced by the coefficient sequence $0\to A_a\xrightarrow{\ell^b}A_{a+b}\to A_b\to0$ and its corresponding sequence of Tate lines. Cones and distinguished triangles have their usual derived meaning [def-weil-triangulated-category]; the cohomology sheaves of each $C_r$ are bounded below.

source.place: Expose XVI, Proposition 3.3.2, printed p.245: compatible Godement cocycles for the fundamental classes and triangles C(mu) -> C(mu+nu) -> C(nu); coefficient compatibility of Proposition 3.3.1.

proof.text: Write $L_r=A_{r,X}(c)$. The finite Tate-line theorem [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback] identifies $q_{N,r}:L_N\to L_r$ with reduction in a local root basis: take a primitive $\ell^N$-th root and its $\ell^{N-r}$-th power, then take $c$ tensor powers (for $c=0$ use $1$). Thus $L_r=L_N/\ell^rL_N$. Define $t_{r,N}:L_r\to L_N$ by $t_{r,N}(q_{N,r}(x))=\ell^{N-r}x$. This is independent of the lift, injective, and compatible in $N$; locally all three assertions are the corresponding calculation in $\mathbf Z/\ell^N$. In particular $0\to L_a\xrightarrow{t_{a,a+b}}L_{a+b}\xrightarrow{q_{a+b,b}}L_b\to0$ is exact. Form the abelian sheaf $M=\operatorname{colim}_r(L_r,t_{r,r+1})$ using [lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaves-filtered-colimits-exact]. Multiplication by $\ell$ on $M$ is epi, since a local section of $L_r$ lifts under $q_{r+1,r}$ and its lift multiplied by $\ell$ equals its image under $t_{r,r+1}$. Moreover $M[\ell^r]=L_r$: for $N\geq r$, the kernel of $\ell^r$ on $L_N$ is exactly $t_{r,N}L_r$, and filtered exactness passes this kernel calculation to the colimit. In these identifications the inclusions of torsion layers are $t$, and multiplication by $\ell^{N-r}$ is $q$. No simultaneous trivialization of the infinite tower is required.

proof.text: Choose a nonnegative abelian injective resolution $M\to I^\bullet$: [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-enough-injectives] embeds $M$ into $I^0$ and each successive cokernel into $I^{q+1}$, with differential the cokernel projection followed by that embedding. Apply [lem-per-divisible-torsion-supported-injective-models] to this $M$ and this single resolution. It gives nonnegative complexes $K_r$ with $QK_r\simeq i_r^!L_r$ and $E_r=\Gamma(Z,K_r)$, computing the derived Hom groups by global cocycles. All coefficient rows are degreewise exact, including on $E_r$, and $q_{N,r}$ is represented by multiplication by $\ell^{N-r}$. By the Tate-line comparison of the same finite twist theorem, $L_r=A_{r,X}(c)$. Here $i_r^!$ is the adjoint of [def-per-closed-support-plus-adjunction], whereas $\eta_r$ of [lem-per-regular-immersion-class-calculus] lands in the exceptional adjoint $i^\times$ of [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint] for the compactification $(\mathrm{id},i)$: a right adjoint of $Rf_!=Ri_*\circ D\mathrm{id}_!$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support], i.e. of the exact $i_*$ on unbounded derived categories. The right adjoint $Ri^!$ of $i_*$ in [lem-exc-closed-ambient] is another such adjoint, so $i^\times\cong Ri^!$ uniquely and compatibly with both adjunctions, and by [def-per-closed-support-plus-adjunction] the restriction of $Ri^!$ to bounded-below objects is the chosen $i_r^!$. Hence $i^\times L_r[2c]\cong i_r^!L_r[2c]$ in $D^+(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A_r)$, and under this isomorphism a map $A_{r,Z}\to(-)$ corresponds on both sides to the same map $i_*A_{r,Z}\to L_r[2c]$ in $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A_r)$. Since $i_*$ commutes with restriction of scalars, the identification respects reduction of coefficients. We transport $\eta_r$ along it, so a cone of the transported map is a cone of the class of [lem-per-regular-immersion-class-calculus] itself.

source.place: Expose XVI, Propositions 3.3.1 and 3.3.2, printed p.245; agent reconstruction by divisible-sheaf injective layers instead of the excluded Godement model

proof.text: Set $m=2c$. The actual classes $\eta_r$ of [lem-per-regular-immersion-class-calculus] correspond to classes in $H^m(E_r)$ by [lem-per-divisible-torsion-supported-injective-models]; coefficient reduction carries each one to the preceding one. Choose a representative $z_1$. Given $z_r$, take any representative $w$ for $\eta_{r+1}$. Then $\ell w-z_r=dv$ for some $v\in E_r^{m-1}$. Degreewise surjectivity of $\ell:E_{r+1}\to E_r$ supplies $\widetilde v$ with $\ell\widetilde v=v$; put $z_{r+1}=w-d\widetilde v$. It represents $\eta_{r+1}$ and satisfies $\ell z_{r+1}=z_r$. For $m=0$ the difference is zero already, as $E_r^{-1}=0$. Induction chooses one family for all $r$, and gives $\ell^{N-r}z_N=z_r$ for every $N\geq r$. The maps $s_r:A_{r,Z}[0]\to K_r[m]$ sending $1$ to $z_r$ are genuine cochain maps representing $\eta_r$, by the cocycle normalization in the torsion-layer lemma.

source.place: Expose XVI, Propositions 3.3.1 and 3.3.2, printed p.245; agent reconstruction by divisible-sheaf injective layers instead of the excluded Godement model

proof.text: Fix $a,b\geq1$ and $N=a+b$. The maps $s_r$ give a strict morphism from the source coefficient row $0\to A_{a,Z}[0]\xrightarrow{\ell^b}A_{N,Z}[0]\to A_{b,Z}[0]\to0$ to the target row $0\to K_a[m]\xrightarrow{\mathrm{incl}}K_N[m]\xrightarrow{\ell^a}K_b[m]\to0$ from [lem-per-divisible-torsion-supported-injective-models]. On $1$, the left square reads $\mathrm{incl}(z_a)=\ell^b z_N$, and the right square reads $\ell^a z_N=z_b$; both are the identities just proved. These checks fix both coefficient arrows, including the injection of the Tate lines. For every $r$, take the explicit cone $C_r=\operatorname{Cone}(s_r)$ of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]: $C_r^n=K_r^{n+m}\oplus(A_{r,Z}[0])^{n+1}$ and $d(y,x)=(d_{K_r[m]}y+s_r x,-d_Ax)$. Its cone triangle shows that $QC_r$ is a cone of the actual $\eta_r$, not just of some map with the same source and target.

source.place: Expose XVI, Propositions 3.3.1 and 3.3.2, printed p.245; agent reconstruction by divisible-sheaf injective layers instead of the excluded Godement model

proof.text: The two strict squares induce cochain maps $C_a\to C_N\to C_b$, given in degree $n$ by $(y,x)\mapsto(y,\ell^b x)$ and $(y,x)\mapsto(\ell^a y,\bar x)$. Their composite is zero, and the two summand rows in every degree are the exact target and source coefficient rows. Hence $0\to C_a\to C_N\to C_b\to0$ is degreewise short exact in $A_N$-module sheaves. By [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] its localized sequence extends to a distinguished triangle $C_a\to C_N\to C_b\to C_a[1]$. The cone choices were made before $a,b$ were fixed, so this works for every pair with the same $C_r$. Finally $C_r^n=0$ for $n<\min(-2c,-1)$, by its displayed terms. Thus each cone and each triangle lies in the bounded-below derived subcategory [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], as claimed.

One new technical lemma concerns the finite torsion layers of a divisible abelian sheaf injective resolution; the item constructs the divisible Tate sheaf, chooses compatible cocycles by explicit boundary lifting, checks both coefficient squares and takes termwise cones.

tool_uses.why: Finite ordinary-etale Tate lines and root-normalized exponent change give the finite coefficient bases; no adic or arbitrary-field duality is used.
Generic existence and exactness of filtered colimits construct the divisible Tate sheaf from its finite torsion layers.
Generic existence of abelian injective resolutions on the small etale site; the Fourier/perverse unit does not provide this foundational tool.

Only its statement that the exceptional i^x named in the cited class-calculus target is a right adjoint of Rf_! (= i_* for a closed immersion); used to identify that target with the bounded-below closed-support adjoint, no exceptional-functor theory of another unit is used.

Only its statement that i_* has a right adjoint Ri^! on ordinary unbounded derived categories, of which def-per-closed-support-plus-adjunction is the bounded-below restriction; generic adjunction bookkeeping.

Source: ILO XVI 3.3.1–3.3.2 (printed p.245) matches the item statement: compatible cocycles, privileged cones, triangles in D^+(Y, Z/ℓ^{μ+ν}). The divisible-sheaf injective-layer route is an agent reconstruction and proof_origin says so. Stacks 0DD7 (lemma-torsion) and 09XQ (sections-with-support-acyclic) were checked at their labels.

Step checks:
- Step 1: t(q x)=ℓ^{N-r}x is well defined, injective and compatible in N. M=colim L_r has ℓ epi and M[ℓ^r]=L_r.
- Step 3: the boundary-lifting induction is correct, using surjectivity of E_{r+1}→E_r from the a=1 row; m=0 is trivial.
- Step 4: both squares hold (incl z_a=ℓ^b z_N and ℓ^a z_N=z_b). The cone matches the def-weil-abstract-derived-category convention; m=2c is even.
- Step 5: the cone maps are chain maps and the sequence is degreewise exact. The triangle comes from complex-ses-triangle, and C_r^n=0 for n<min(-2c,-1).

New node lem-per-divisible-torsion-supported-injective-models:
- It is statement-only and self-contained, and it is true. ℓ^r is onto on injectives, so J_r resolves F_r. J_r^q is A_r-injective. H_Z preserves injectives, so K is injective and its sections are divisible, which makes the J, K and E rows exact. The scalar-restriction clause holds because I[ℓ^r] is i^!-acyclic.
- Small cases tested: Q_ℓ/Z_ℓ on a point, Z empty, c=0, a=b=1.
- It is not a clause of the item, and no duplicate was found in the DAG (rg -L).

Fault, repaired by FIX (C4/E4):
- Step 2 treated two adjoints as the same: η_r of class-calculus lands in the exceptional i^× of thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint, which lives on unbounded categories. The new node computes the D^+ adjoint of def-per-closed-support-plus-adjunction.
- Step 2 now bridges them. For compactification (id,i), Rf_!=i_* (def-amb-etale-compact-support). Uniqueness of right adjoints gives i^×≅Ri^! of lem-exc-closed-ambient. def-per says its i^! is the D^+ restriction of that adjoint. Both Hom sets are Hom_{D(X)}(i_*A_{r,Z}, L_r[2c]), so the reduction compatibility transfers.
- Changes: four uses added to step 2, proof_deps recomputed, and tool_uses added for thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint and lem-exc-closed-ambient.

Accepted tool_uses: finite-twist-pullback, filtered-colimits, enough-injectives.
